raw.body:
Opened #37032 addressing the largest finding here: the 30 near-identical generator functions in `compiler/packages/snap/src/minimize.ts`.

Most of them followed one of two shapes:
- Remove one item at a time from a node's collection (statements, call arguments, function params, array/object elements, JSX attributes/children, destructuring pattern elements)
- Replace a matching node with one of its child fields (conditionals, if/while/for/try statements, binary/logical/member expressions, etc)

Extracted two generic helpers, `removeCollectionItems` and `simplifyByReplacement`, and rewrote the applicable generators in terms of them. File went from about 2300 lines to about 1320 lines with no behavior change intended (verified with `yarn snap minimize` against a hand built fixture).

Left the pipeline pass duplication (`ts-compile-fixture.ts`) and the scattered binding check pattern out of scope for this PR since minimize.ts was the single largest and most self contained finding.
